scope: Assessment design only. Full case inputs, clinical answer keys, canonical objectives and validated standards are not supplied.

rows.objectiveWording: Distinguish acute and subacute presentations in supplied cases.

rows.baselinePrompt: Using the supplied evidence and reference: Distinguish acute and subacute presentations in supplied cases. State the evidence supporting each conclusion and identify missing information.
rows.transferPrompt: Repeat the task after one relevant supplied finding or patient-context constraint changes. Explain which conclusion changes, which remains supported, and why.
scoringDimensions: Justifies conclusions using the supplied reference
rows.scoreRecording: Record each dimension separately as absent/incorrect or explicit/correct; record prompting separately.
